model.name: ONE physical unit store; every other index/view is a symlink tree into it (a duplicate physical store is forbidden)
model.description: Tron architectural directive verbatim (relayed via PO 2026-09-05): he does NOT want a data model-store; units can have ln links in redundant index trees, so we can have a model-tree FOLDER but NOT a duplicate index. THE PRINCIPLE: ONE physical store of unit files (scenario/index), every other index or view is a SYMLINK tree into it, a duplicate PHYSICAL store is forbidden. MEASURED current state: scenario/index = 5947 real files / 0 symlink (the one store); data/model-store = 777 real files / 0 symlink (a 2nd physical store = the violation); 33 UUIDs are real files in BOTH (byte-identical now, no divergence yet, NO rule for which wins if they do); 744 model-store units are model-store-ONLY (so 'delete the dupes' alone leaves 744 = rule half-applied). Correct shape already exists elsewhere: data/users room-file dirs are 53/53 symlinks into scenario/index (+ R17.5 speaking-name tree, sprints.json). The gate that FAILS on a duplicate real file for an existing UUID is the by-construction guarantee.

model.rootFraming: ROOT OF ALL (Tron 2026-09-06, PO-relayed): the ONE store is the PRECONDITION every other path resolves against — drop/upload/render/traceability ALL READ the store, so a SPLIT store REGENERATES all of them (a 2nd physical store re-forks every reader that resolves a unit). Fixing R40.81 first is why the drop/upload/render fixes can hold: they resolve against ONE canonical store, not a which-store fork. R40.81 = CURRENT anchor; the drop/upload path (R37.20 family + R40.103) is NEXT, riding behind the root.
